event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review your symptoms in this message thread today during service hours; burning and increased frequency can indicate a bladder infection, and a clinician can assess you remotely and decide whether testing or treatment is needed. If that review isn't available today, contact your usual doctor or a walk-in clinic instead. Separately, don't wait for a reply if you develop fever, chills, back or side pain, vomiting, or blood in your urine — seek same-day in-person care.
